name: Fam-Trastuzumab Deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd)
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (trastuzumab linked to a topoisomerase-1 inhibitor payload, deruxtecan): modeled here for HER2-positive metastatic disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). The guideline also supports use in HER2-low disease (IHC 1+ or 2+/ISH-negative), which is a separate indication not modeled here. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer.

lineOfTherapy: second-line (category 1, preferred) and beyond for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer; single-agent use may be considered first-line for select patients with rapid progression per guideline footnote

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: no active interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis; monitor for ILD/pneumonitis during therapy

drugs.name: Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd)

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 10 of 15, Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1, cycled every 21 days

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 10 of 15. Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1, every 21 days. The BREAST dose is 5.4 mg/kg (weight-based). Do NOT apply the DeVita gastric/esophagogastric value of 6.4 mg/m2 (line 99219, DESTINY-Gastric) to breast cancer. Same 5.4 mg/kg every-21-day dose is used adjuvantly for 14 cycles in high-risk residual HER2-positive disease (DESTINY-Breast11, BINV-M 7 of 10).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: T-DXd is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; provide prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier (verify exact NCCN antiemesis tier).

supportiveCare: Pulmonary: monitor for interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis, a serious class toxicity; discontinue for confirmed ILD per guidance (BINV-Q 3 of 15 footnote o).
Antiemetics: provide prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF before and during HER2-targeted therapy.

monitoring: pulmonary symptoms and imaging for ILD/pneumonitis

doseModificationRules.condition: any grade of confirmed interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis
doseModificationRules.text: Hold for suspected ILD; permanently discontinue for confirmed symptomatic (grade 2 or higher) ILD/pneumonitis per labeling and guideline (BINV-Q 3 of 15 footnote o). Obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 22102 to 22107 (T-DXd listed among HER2/ERBB2-amplified breast cancer therapy options); NOTE the numeric dose in DeVita (6.4 mg/m2, line 99219) is the esophagogastric/gastric dose and is NOT used here

guideline.locator: Dosing: Cytotoxic Regimens for Recurrent/Stage IV Disease, HER2-Positive, Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1 every 21 days, BINV-Q 10 of 15; line placement (second line, category 1 preferred) BINV-Q 3 of 15; ILD caution footnote o

sources.name: DeVita 12th ed. (core)
sources.value: 6.4 mg/m2 IV every 3 weeks in HER2-positive esophagogastric/gastric adenocarcinoma (DESTINY-Gastric-01, line 99219)

sources.name: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer
sources.value: 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1 every 21 days for HER2-positive breast cancer (BINV-Q 10 of 15)

divergence.note: DeVita only provides a T-DXd dose for the gastric setting (6.4 mg/m2, BSA-based). The breast dose is 5.4 mg/kg (weight-based) and is a different number, unit, and basis. The breast (NCCN) value is used; the gastric DeVita value must never be applied to breast cancer. This is exactly the wrong-dose failure mode to guard against.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd). Serves subtype #4 (HER2-positive) metastatic breast cancer, histology-agnostic across invasive ductal (#1) and invasive lobular (#2) carcinoma. DeVita names T-DXd among HER2-positive breast options (lines 22102 to 22107) but provides only a gastric dose (6.4 mg/m2, line 99219); the correct BREAST dose is 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1 every 21 days, sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-Q 10 of 15. A divergence is recorded to prevent applying the gastric 6.4 mg/m2 value to breast cancer. Modeled as metastatic (cycles null, until progression, second line category 1 preferred); the same dose is used adjuvantly for 14 cycles in high-risk residual disease per the guideline (noted). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
